note: Checklists for the Nigerian passport (Port Harcourt resident, tourism, about 14 nights, US-citizen partner who may pay). Steps are in the order to gather them. (unconfirmed) marks items only secondary sources gave.

packs.title: Before any trip: both travellers
packs.startBy: As soon as a destination is chosen
steps: Check both passports are valid at least 6 months past the return date, with 2 or more blank pages.
Nigerian traveller: find the original yellow fever certificate (Kenya, Senegal, Cape Verde, Tanzania, Thailand, Malaysia, Sri Lanka and Barbados may ask for it).
Decide who pays for what; if the US partner pays, get 3 months of their bank statements and a signed letter of support (dates, purpose, costs covered).
Nigerian traveller: ask the employer now for a letter confirming the job, salary and approved leave dates.
Buy travel insurance that covers medical care and repatriation (Schengen needs EUR 30,000; Kenya and Tanzania require their own policies).
Hold flight reservations, not paid tickets, until the visa is approved, or buy refundable fares.
In the last 72 hours: fill in the arrival form the destination uses (Visit Japan Web, TDAC, MDAC, EASE, Barbados travel form).

packs.title: Thailand e-Visa (tourist)
packs.where: Online at thaievisa.go.th, under the Royal Thai Embassy in Abuja (online only since 1 Jan 2025)
packs.fee: About 1,000 THB (~$30 to $40), paid online, not refundable (unconfirmed: the embassy doesn't publish it)
packs.time: Usually 15 business days; some cases 4 to 6 weeks
packs.startBy: About 6 weeks before the first night, because of the two Nigerian clearances
steps: Check the passport is valid at least 6 months beyond the date of entry into Thailand.
Apply now for the NDLEA visa clearance (mandatory for Nigerian passports).
Apply now for a police clearance certificate from POSSAP (mandatory for Nigerian passports).
Have a passport photo taken (no older than 6 months).
Get a recent bank statement with at least NGN 2,000,000 and 3 months of transactions; if the partner co-funds, add their statement and letter of support (unconfirmed that it counts).
Get proof of accommodation: hotel bookings for every night.
Get a confirmed round-trip flight reservation.
Optional: a day-by-day plan or tour bookings.
Fill in the form on thaievisa.go.th, upload everything and pay.
After approval: print the e-Visa, and fill in the Thailand Digital Arrival Card within 3 days before arrival.

sources.label: Royal Thai Embassy Abuja: e-Visa requirements

packs.title: Japan tourist visa
packs.where: In person at the VFS Japan Visa Application Centre in Abuja or Lagos (Embassy of Japan in Nigeria)
packs.fee: JPY 15,000 single entry since 1 July 2026 (the embassy's naira table may still show the old NGN 31,300; check at VFS), plus VFS service fee
packs.time: At least 12 working days in Abuja, 14 in Lagos
packs.startBy: About 30 days before the first night
steps: Check the passport has 2 blank pages and is valid for the whole stay.
Fill in the visa application form (typed is best) and sign it by hand, matching the passport signature; attach a photo to the embassy's spec.
Print a flight itinerary with flight numbers and every time (leaving Nigeria, transit, in and out of Japan). Don't buy tickets yet.
Fill in the embassy's "Travel Itinerary in Japan" form: a daily plan with hotel names, addresses and phone numbers (bookings not required).
Get the original bank statement for the last 3 months from whoever pays; if the US partner pays, add their statement and a signed letter of sponsorship.
Get an original certificate of employment on letterhead (start date, position, salary, signer); self-employed: a letter of self-introduction.
Recommended: the employer's company tax clearance and certificate of incorporation.
Submit in person at VFS Abuja or Lagos (closed weekends and Nigerian holidays).

sources.label: Embassy of Japan in Nigeria: visa

packs.title: Egypt tourist visa (embassy)
packs.where: In person at the Egyptian embassy in Abuja or the consulate general in Lagos (no e-visa or visa on arrival for Nigerians)
packs.fee: Ask the embassy; fees for Nigerians were revised in 2025 (unconfirmed)
packs.time: 1 to 3 weeks reported, plus a possible security-clearance wait (unconfirmed)
packs.startBy: About 6 weeks before the first night
packs.note: No official checklist could be found online, so this list is built from secondary sources. Phone the embassy first: the published addresses disagree.
steps: Phone the embassy or consulate to confirm the current form, fee and opening hours.
Check the passport is valid 6 months beyond the stay.
Fill in the embassy application form and add 2 passport photos.
Get a return flight reservation and hotel bookings for the whole stay.
Get 3 to 6 months of bank statements and an employment letter; if the partner pays, add their letter of support and statement.
Write a short cover letter with the itinerary (Cairo, Aswan, Nile cruise, Luxor).
Submit in person and allow several weeks for a security clearance (unconfirmed).

sources.label: Sahara Reporters: Egypt revises fees for Nigerians (2025)

packs.title: Schengen visa for Germany
packs.where: German Consulate General in Lagos (Abuja only for special categories); appointments through an online waiting list
packs.fee: EUR 90, paid in naira at the day's rate; not refundable
packs.time: Up to 15 calendar days after the appointment; the waiting list comes first
packs.startBy: About 3 months before the first night (join the waiting list now)
packs.note: Appointments are given in date order from the waiting list, and the consulate says requests for special appointments have no chance, so a January or February 2027 trip is doubtful. A Verpflichtungserklaerung is only for sponsors living in Germany; a US partner uses a letter of support instead (unconfirmed).
steps: Join the appointment waiting list on the consulate's online booking system (free, one per person); print the confirmation.
Fill in the VIDEX application form, then sign it with place and date.
Sign the section 54 AufenthG declaration and the data-protection form.
Copy the passport data page; add the birth certificate and copies of any earlier Schengen visas.
Buy Schengen travel health insurance with at least EUR 30,000 cover.
Get a flight reservation, proof of accommodation and a travel itinerary.
Get stamped bank statements (3 to 6 months is typical; unconfirmed); if the partner pays, add their letter of support, statements and passport copy.
Get proof of ties to Nigeria: employment letter with approved leave, company documents, property or family.
Bring 2 biometric photos (35 x 45 mm), all originals and a prepaid courier envelope.
Sort the file exactly in the checklist's order: unsorted files are rejected.

sources.label: German missions in Nigeria: tourist checklist (June 2026)

packs.title: Schengen visa for Italy
packs.where: Apply at TLScontact Lagos (Ivie House, Victoria Island) or Abuja; the Italian Consulate General in Lagos decides
packs.fee: EUR 90 plus the TLScontact service fee
packs.time: About 15 days after the appointment (unconfirmed); slots fill fast
packs.startBy: About 3 months before the first night
steps: Book an appointment at it.tlscontact.com.
Fill in and sign the Schengen application form.
Check the passport is valid at least 3 months beyond the stay; add 1 recent ICAO-standard photo.
Get a return flight reservation.
Get proof of accommodation: hotel bookings for every night.
Buy health insurance with at least EUR 30,000 cover for medical costs, hospital care and repatriation.
Get an employer letter stating annual leave; business owners add the tax and incorporation certificates.
Add proof of ties to Nigeria, such as a marriage certificate or property documents.
Get bank statements for the last 3 months showing enough funds for the stay; if the partner pays, add their letter of support and statements (unconfirmed).

packs.title: Malaysia eVisa
packs.where: Online at the Malaysian immigration eVisa portal
packs.fee: RM105 processing plus a visa fee set by nationality, about $25 to $45 in total (unconfirmed)
packs.startBy: About 3 weeks before the first night
steps: Check the passport is valid more than 6 months from the travel date.
Scan the passport bio page in colour.
Get a studio passport-size photo, as a digital file.
Get a return flight booking (unconfirmed).
Get hotel bookings (unconfirmed).
Apply and pay on the official eVisa portal.
Print the eVisa on A4 and carry it with the ticket; fill in the free MDAC within 3 days before arrival.

packs.title: Tanzania e-Visa
packs.fee: $50 ordinary single entry (unconfirmed), plus $44 compulsory insurance
packs.time: About 10 working days; allow 2 to 3 weeks
packs.startBy: About 3 weeks before the first night
steps: Check the passport is valid at least 6 months from arrival.
Scan the passport bio page in colour and get a recent passport photo.
Get a return ticket (shown on arrival) and the safari and hotel bookings.
Apply and pay on visa.immigration.go.tz.
Buy the compulsory $44 inbound insurance (one policy covers the mainland and Zanzibar).
Print the e-Visa grant notice and the insurance certificate; carry the yellow fever card.

packs.title: Sri Lanka sponsored visa
packs.where: A sponsor in Sri Lanka applies in person at the Department of Immigration and Emigration, Battaramulla
packs.time: Apply at least a month ahead
packs.startBy: About 6 weeks before the first night
packs.note: Without a sponsor in Sri Lanka (a citizen, a registered tour operator or a hotel) this visa isn't possible.
steps: Find a Sri Lankan sponsor: a citizen, a registered tour operator or a hotel.
Sponsor: write a request letter to the Controller General of Immigration (unconfirmed wording).
Sponsor: swear an affidavit and certify a copy of their national ID card or passport (unconfirmed).
Applicant: copy the passport bio page (valid 6 months or more, 1 blank page).
Applicant: get a police clearance certificate from POSSAP.
Applicant: proof of accommodation, a return ticket, bank statements and the partner's letter of support.
Applicant: Visit Visa Form B and a colour photo (4.5 x 3.5 cm).
Sponsor: lodge everything at Battaramulla; once approved, print and carry the ETA approval.

packs.title: Senegal, Cape Verde, Kenya, Vietnam, Barbados
packs.where: No embassy visit for the Nigerian passport
packs.startBy: See the Paperwork deadlines page (3 to 14 days)
steps: Senegal: nothing to apply for (ECOWAS, 90 days). Carry the original yellow fever certificate and a return ticket.
Cape Verde: register on EASE (ease.gov.cv) at least 5 days before arrival and pay the airport tax; carry the yellow fever card.
Kenya: no eTA for Nigerians since 2025, but check etakenya.go.ke for the new travel insurance rule; carry a return ticket and the yellow fever card.
Vietnam: e-visa on evisa.gov.vn ($25 single entry): upload the passport bio page and a portrait photo; print the approval.
Barbados: no visa; fill in the online immigration and customs form (opens 72 hours before arrival) and carry the yellow fever card.
